capabilities: Embed any vault file as a node
Export boards to PNG, JPEG, or PDF
extras: No network requests or telemetry; .catego files pair a readable DSL block with a lossless snapshot; iPad touch and stylus supported.
intentEvidence: Where core Canvas gives you boxes and lines, Catego gives every box a role and every line a meaning
problem: Core Canvas offers only untyped boxes and lines, so an argument's structure and the logical relations between its parts cannot be expressed or checked.
